core_requests: Engine (WP08 follow-up): KEV/EPSS-ranked CVE fan-out (P183 cond 3) - collect a case's pivot CVEs, run the offline cisa_kev/epss answers first and schedule online per-CVE modules in v3lum.modules.vulnerability_cve.cve_record.plan_cve_fanout order; modules enforce the per-case cap (setting cve_fanout_budget, first come, QUOTA 'quota' = deferred) until then.

QuotaBook (P334): a token-bucket wait should re-queue the (module, entity) pair instead of sleeping up to RATE_WAIT_MAX in the worker (P183 cond 2), and provider quota blocks per key plan (NVD 5 req/30 s keyless vs 50 req/30 s with key 'nvd'; nist_nvd declares the keyless figure).

Renderers (WP14/WP20): for CVE-only cases not linked to an own asset show the g08_cve_card priority line (correlation title/recommendation) instead of the case risk level (P183 cond 6), and render the card's evidence lines grouped (P335).

notes: Four modules for three proposals: cisa_kev (P182, offline dataset, disclosure none), cve_record (P183, cveawg + NVD + CWE catalogue, third_party), epss (P184 cond 1, offline daily file, none) and epss_api (P184 cond 2, third_party, one disclosure class per module). Providers created (hosts mapped to null/absent in owners.json): cisa (www.cisa.gov, cisa.gov), nist_nvd (services.nvd.nist.gov, nvd.nist.gov; key 'nvd' with env alias V3LUM_NVD_KEY; quota block 5 req/30 s at 80%; marker nist_nvd.rolling_window_403), first (api.first.org, epss.empiricalsecurity.com, epss.cyentia.com); the seeded mitre provider is extended by mitre__p1-G08-1.json (hosts cwe.mitre.org for the CWE dataset and www.cve.org for record links; sources mitre.cve_record_cwe_catalog, mitre.cve_record_cve_pages). Datasets: cisa_kev (TTL 6 h, 1.9 MB, not large, validated: complete catalogue, count == entries, >= 1000 valid ids), epss_scores (gz, large, 128 MiB cap, validated: header + >= 100k rows), cwe_catalog (zip stored as-is, 2.1 MB, member read in memory with size/ratio caps, DTD/ENTITY refused, derived name index cached in ctx.state) - all essential. One consolidated CVE card: every module adds facts with provenance (no separate findings); correlation rule g08_cve_card (v3lum/correlations/g08_cve_card.py, fixtures in tests/fixtures/rules/g08_cve_card/) builds one INFO card per CVE with the plain-words priority line ('KEV + EPSS 0.97: patch now'), moves non-CISA 'kev' claims to exploitation evidence and lists own assets linked through has_vuln (severity left to CR15/P291). Batch tests: test_five_cve_modules_give_one_card_and_no_critical_case_level (cisa_kev, epss, epss_api, cve_record + a CIRCL-style CVE 5 source using the shared parser: one node, one card, no CRITICAL) and test_default_scan_of_a_cve_seed_runs_the_cve_modules (plain scan through the policy gate). Shared API for later CVE batches (cve_record.py): parse_cve5_record / cve5_attributes(include_kev=) (P181, P352), cve_fanout_allows + fanout_refusal + setting cve_fanout_budget (P181, P184 API, P185, P186, P188-P191, P354), register_cve_mirror (P352 hook), patch_priority, epss_plain_words, peek_dataset, dataset_failure. Interpretations: epss_api calls FIRST only when the local file is missing or older than the day's model run (a CVE missing from the day's file is also missing from the API, which answers 'OK, total 0' after 6-10 s); cve_record keyword input runs NVD keywordSearch only with key 'nvd' (else SKIPPED 'config'); kev attributes are set only for listed CVEs ('not in KEV' is kev_status text, never kev=False). No LIGHT/ACTIVE variant was asked. The bundled CVE pivot pack was dropped because a core links test lacks a 'cve' fixture value (core request).
